Describe the user-visible change and supported behavior.

- [ ] Keyboard and naming contracts updated when behavior changes
- [ ] Relevant rendered states tested; axe incomplete results inspected
- [ ] Changed components have dated manual audit observations, or a recorded unverified status
- [ ] Theme contrast and narrow-layout checks passed

List checks run and any evidence limitations. A green suite covers only its defined assertions.
